description_en: Retrieves a list of data lake tables
description_zh: 调用此API可获取数据湖表列表
kebab_example: aliyun dms list-data-lake-table --tid 30000 --catalog-name hive --db-name default --table-name-pattern .0 --table-type MANAGED_TABLE --next-token f056501ada120000 --max-results 20 --workspace-id 120000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDataLakeTable

parameters.help_en:
The tenant ID.

> Hover over your profile picture in the upper-right corner of the DMS console to obtain the tenant ID. For details, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
> 取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The name of the data catalog
parameters.name: catalog_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the metadata table. This parameter supports regular expressions
parameters.help_zh: 元数据表名称，正则表达式匹配
parameters.name: table_name_pattern

parameters.help_en:
The type of the table. Valid values:

- MANAGED\_TABLE: Internal table.

- EXTERNAL\_TABLE: External table.

- VIRTUAL\_VIEW: Virtual view.

- INDEX\_TABLE: Index table.

- MATERIALIZED\_VIEW: Materialized view
parameters.help_zh:
数据表的类型，取值如下：

- MANAGED\_TABLE：内部表。

- EXTERNAL\_TABLE：外部表。

- VIRTUAL\_VIEW：虚拟视图。

- INDEX\_TABLE：索引表。

- MATERIALIZED\_VIEW：物化视图
parameters.name: table_type

parameters.help_en:
The token used to retrieve the next page of results. To retrieve the next page, set this parameter to the \`NextToken\` value from the previous response. If you do not specify this parameter, the first page is returned.

- If **NextToken** is empty, there are no more queries.

- If **NextToken** has a value, the value is the token to start the next query
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

- 如果**NextToken**为空表示没有下一次查询。
- 如果**NextToken**有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is 100
parameters.name: max_results
